summary: Verified heist audio preload bug fix (heistLib.jsx _audioBank/preloadHeistAudio/playHeistSound). Used Playwright request interceptor to confirm mp3 GETs happen AT MOUNT (before heist strike timers). Zero uncaught console/pageerror across all 11 themes, forced heist, and muted state.

winter.note: owl-hoot/wing-whoosh not observed at mount — OwlHeist likely gated by season/date logic; snow-gust preload confirms fix works for winter primary heist

fairy.note: No mp3s observed at mount for fairy theme; fairy companion may not mount here — likely mapping/conditional gating rather than preload regression. Non-critical per request scope.

action_items: Optional (informational, non-blocking): investigate why 'fairy' theme did not fetch fairy-laugh.mp3 / pixie-chime.mp3 at mount while 'dark' theme did — likely correct mapping (fairy companion mounts on specific themes) but worth confirming. Winter theme did not preload owl-hoot/wing-whoosh at mount (OwlHeist appears gated separately).
critical_code_review_comments: heistLib.jsx preloadHeistAudio/playHeistSound implementation is clean: honors ff_muted, uses warm bank, has fresh-element fallback, catches play() promise rejections silently — resolves the mobile delay RCA correctly.
All 9 sound-emitting heist components correctly call preloadHeistAudio in a mount useEffect and playHeistSound at strike time.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for critical assertions (cyber/fantasy/winter preload + zero errors across 11 themes + forced heist + mute)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for delayed heist audio (mount-time preload) is verified. Theme localStorage key is 'ff_theme'. Force heist events confirmed: ff:gears-heist, ff:abduct, ff:ghost-heist, ff:spear-heist, ff:snowman-heist, ff:owl-heist, ff:petal-heist, ff:breath-heist, ff:surf-heist, ff:pixie-heist, ff:neon-crash. All heist components preload via preloadHeistAudio in useEffect and play via playHeistSound. Some heists (Owl, fairy companion, cardinal) mount based on season/companion conditions rather than raw ff_theme.
